reports.text: The pavement, as of May 2016, is in perfect condition.
As long as the roadway is clean, the pavement is great!
Omg! Virtually every turn, and there are lots of them, is banked perfectly.
Go through the foothills and enjoy the long sweeping turns.
I guess there's scenery around this spectacular road, but who's paying attention?
